title: Research audit: exact interior-carry criterion for compact controls (no new kappa)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**Mathematical audit / research note; no new kappa.** Outside the retained good set, the earlier-source compact-control word can get the target right while corrupting a dirty temporary. The retained guard is correct. This contribution proves the exact full-map agreement criterion when every temporary digit is nonsaturated:

`g_i + z_i*t_i < A` for every `i < n-1`, where `A=2^(K-1)` and `B=2^G`.

The final outgoing target carry is harmless. The resulting invariant good fraction is exactly `((B-1)/B)^n * (1-(B-2)/(4*A))^(n-1)`. At `n=2,K=6,G=2`, it is `567/1024` instead of the old guard's `9/64`. This is a repair-envelope improvement, not a runtime claim. The proof retains all four swaps, four rotations, highest-bit completion and complete inherited exceptional-repair charges.

Only `research/compact-guard-audit-seed71/` is added. No production predicate, supplier, selected certificate or upstream file changes. Later-source extension, physical tape/compiler realization, recursive hosting/precision, analytic transfer and the full multiplication theorem remain outside scope.

## Task and overlap

Base and refreshed main: `1b59b624d21924f8e3537cdc1ac52d3be6eda2fe`. OS-random seed **71**, adversarial audit; `CLAIM.json` records three candidates, the bounded experiment and local claim. No pinned coordination issue exists.

Domain: `n>=1`, `G>=1`, `K>=G+1`, `0<=rho<K`, and `t_i<=B-2`. The written argument is universal in that domain; finite coverage is listed separately in `EXPECTED.json`. `SOURCES.json` pins the actual movement note, interpreter and import closure with SHA256 and Git blobs.

Nearest overlap: #763 at `a5d3436b82f5a58033ec6b490ebb23db0c1860c6` studies later-source compact-load carries while retaining the old target guard; #1108 at `b76bb2853be4e7001508582b10913e32ad7aba9f` proves a one-digit boundary law. This adds the multi-digit target-carry iff, dirty-field necessity, and exact envelope density. #735/#773 concern the different wide-slot gadget. The predecessor heads and newly updated PRs were refreshed before submission; no predecessor code from those PRs is imported.

## Validation

```sh
python3 -I -O -B research/compact-guard-audit-seed71/test_package.py
```

Expected: `PASS_COMPACT_GUARD_AUDIT states=1679360 source_samples=1536 domains=6 no_new_kappa`, then `PASS_COMPACT_GUARD_PACKAGE ... faults=7`.

CPython 3.14.6/macOS arm64: the minimal relocated optimized replay passes. Evidence includes 1,679,360 complete finite quotient states, 161,448 local cases, 1,536 physical predecessor samples, every sorted-repair payload, and 89,360 target-only false acceptances. Seven subprocess controls reject source drift, a nonstrict guard, forbidding the final carry, target-only checking, omitted highest XOR, receipt drift and occupied output. All 17 existing compact-control tests and `make selected-record-check` pass.

No full repository suite, selected supplier cold replay, hosted CI result or proof-assistant verification is claimed. Finite execution supports the written proof; it does not formalize the full multiplication theorem.
